question: Should Crabbox own and publish this Zed task extension as a supported first-party integration, including its declared platform and task-contract scope?
rationale: The patch introduces a new editor-facing package rather than repairing an established contract; code review cannot determine the repository’s long-term ownership and support commitment.

options.title: Adopt with explicit support scope
options.body: Confirm first-party ownership after redacted real-Zed proof is added and document the supported platforms and task contract.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Decline first-party ownership and direct the work to an independently maintained Zed extension instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt with explicit support scope
recommendation.body: Confirm first-party ownership after redacted real-Zed proof is added and document the supported platforms and task contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct authorship of the final integration and workflow changes makes this the strongest available routing signal.
